name: Nicodemus
title: Teacher of Israel
summary: Nicodemus was a Pharisee and member of the Sanhedrin who came to Jesus at night. Jesus told him about the necessity of being born again. Nicodemus gradually developed from a nighttime questioner into someone who defended Jesus, and finally helped bury him.

keyEvents.title: The Night Visit
keyEvents.description: Nicodemus came to Jesus at night and heard about the necessity of being born again.

keyEvents.title: John 3:16
keyEvents.description: In his conversation with Nicodemus, Jesus spoke the Bible's most famous verse.

keyEvents.title: Defended Jesus in the Council
keyEvents.description: Nicodemus argued for justice when the council wanted to seize Jesus without a hearing.

keyEvents.title: Helped with the burial
keyEvents.description: Nicodemus brought a costly mixture of myrrh and aloes to anoint Jesus' body for burial.
